rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects to Telegram via the Telethon MTProto library, providing comprehensive account-level access for cyber threat intelligence workflows. Supports chat and group management, messaging with inline buttons and polls, contact operations, media upload/download, sticker sets, privacy settings, and public chat discovery. Includes a deny-by-default file-path allowlist for secure file operations and Docker deployment support.
